scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/database generate && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/database exec prisma generate && corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/database build && corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/storage build && corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/domain build
scripts.build:apps: corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/worker build && corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/web build
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:responsive: corepack pnpm build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/e2e/sante-responsive.spec.ts
scripts.db:seed-local-p03: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @cercle/database exec tsx ../../scripts/seed-local-p03.ts
scripts.db:seed-local-full: corepack pnpm db:seed-local && corepack pnpm db:seed-local-p03
